layers.text: Camera: a single item sprite shown whole and centred on a transparent background, a slight three-quarter angle looking a little down, filling most of the square with a small margin, nothing cropped.

Faction: sturdy cheerful steampunk craft of the deep mountain forges. Its fixed colours: soot-black riveted iron with a thin light warm grey highlight along every lit edge; bright polished copper pipes, boilers and bands, colour #c27c3a; dark brown leather straps and aprons; small puffs of pure white steam from smokestacks; small details of rivets and gears.

layers.text: Subject: a burrow mound with a rider: one low wide round heap of freshly dug dark brown earth with a few small grey rocks, the shining tip of a big cone-shaped copper drill breaking up through its top, and beside it the riveted soot-black iron head of a war hammer banded in copper sticking up out of the earth, with one small puff of white steam; wider than tall; the bottom of the heap is the lowest thing in the image.
Only the heap of earth with the drill tip and the hammer head: no machine body, no person and no creature anywhere.
